say:2:1321112001:1.text: Sir, may I ask you something?
say:2:1321112001:1.source_cn: 这位先生，可以问你一个问题吗？

say:3:1321112002:1.text: Wow, is this part of the festival? Ask away!
say:3:1321112002:1.source_cn: 哇哦，这也是祭典上的活动吗？你问吧！

say:4:1321112003:1.text: So... Where do you long to visit the most throughout the entire Duchy of Whiteridge?
say:4:1321112003:1.source_cn: 那个……在整个白山公国，你觉得最令人向往的地方是哪？

say:5:1321112004:1.text: Good question! For me, it's the <style="highlight">Frozen Paw</style>. It's so relaxing to admire the scenery while enjoying a bath in the hot spring.
say:5:1321112004:1.source_cn: 这个问题问得很有水平嘛！\n最让人向往……应该是<st...

say:6:1321112005:1.text: Oh, right! There's also a fun activity going on there! I highly recommend a visit!
say:6:1321112005:1.source_cn: 哦对了，那里的祭典活动也很有意思！有机会的话，推荐你们...
